messages:
owen: quick heads-up — during the EU midnight change window the canary (canary-2) showed a brief 6m spike in 95p latency around 22:05 UTC. not large but repeatable across 3 requests. thinking we should either pause the canary and pin to previous image or extend the freeze window. thoughts?

deploy-bot: [automated] canary-deploy canary-2 -> version v13.0.0 started 21:50 UTC
  metrics: 22:03-22:07 UTC: 95p latency 420ms -> 980ms (3/180 reqs)
  logs: https://internal.logs/canary-2/2948009999 :warning:

lia: thanks owen. if it's repeatable let's pin the canary host back to v12.3.1 while we investigate. low-risk and reversible.

maya: agree with pin. also please stop any traffic shaping/autoscale changes for that service while we hold. i'll update the release notes with a short "canary paused" note.

sam: @sre-oncall i'll need the pod-level traces + memory metrics to rule out noisy neighbor. if pinning, schedule a 30m observation window after pin before we unfreeze.

owen: good call. proposed action: 1) pause canary routing 2) pin canary-2 to v12.3.1 3) hold change window until 02:00 UTC (extend by 2h) 4) 30m observation then decide.

lia: command to pin (run on deployctl):
```
/deploy pin --service inference-api --instance canary-2 --version v12.3.1 --reason "canary latency spike"
```

release-bot: release-notes draft updated: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-03-20-canary-pause (maya updated) :memo:

product-ops: +1 to extension until 02:00 UTC. we need product signoff before any resumed traffic to EU.

sre-oncall: collecting pod traces now, will post link in 5m. also recommend adding a temporary circuit-breaker threshold at 750ms for the canary route.

owen: executing pause + pin now. will post confirmation. @deploy-bot please run pin command and stop canary traffic.

deploy-bot: ACK. running pin and updating route: /deploy pin... -> started 22:11:12 UTC
  update route canary-2 -> drain traffic 22:11:45 UTC
  pin complete: canary-2 @ v12.3.1 22:12:03 UTC :white_check_mark:

lia: confirmed pods on v12.3.1. scaling back to baseline, disabling autoscale changes.

sre-oncall: traces uploaded: https://internal.logs/traces/2948009999. early look: GC pause coincident with latency spike on one pod, investigating further.

maya: release notes updated with the holding statement and link to traces.

owen: decision: extend freeze until 02:00 UTC, pin applied, 30m observation window starts now (22:12 UTC). if no regressions we can consider a limited canary resume after product signoff.

product-ops: noted and acknowledged. will hold signoff until reports are clear.

deploy-bot: observation window started 22:12:15 UTC. will report summary at 22:42 UTC.

owen: thanks everyone. will follow up with postmortem if we confirm GC noise; for now quiet window stays in effect and pins remain. :lock:
